must_mention.point: A Preflight script instead of the LLM filter, because deduplication needs memory across events
STATE_FILE plus item id paygate:event_id with version = replay_seq, so a manual replay counts as a new occurrence
Transient retries and recoveries are skipped; the final attempt or a non-retryable signature failure goes through

must_mention.point: Timeout set within 1–300 s; a timeout, non-zero exit or invalid output stops the event with no automatic retry
Run now bypasses Preflight, so it does not test the filter
Which parts ran live and which ran on the offline fixture replay

repeated_words: "and" chained five times in the framing

accuracy.anchor: Two of seven points (mm1 hedged, mm4); the dedupe mechanism was wrong and no risks were stated (anchor: 6–11 = two or three points).

structure.anchor: The framing was a feature tour; the update had no evidence and no ask (anchor: 6–10 = order lost).

customer_relevance.anchor: The numbers came last and were hedged; nothing for finance (anchor: 5–8 = the customer has to dig).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Every segment off target, the objections 60 s short; nine fillers and two long pauses (anchor: 3–5 = most segments off, fillers over 1/min).

recovery.anchor: Both objections dismissed without acknowledgement, evidence or offer (anchor: 0–4 = pattern absent).

stems: "Today, … notifications turn into … sessions. After this change, …" — open with the outcome, not a list of Automation parts.
"Same event id and replay number means same investigation." — a rule the script enforces, not something a filter "thinks".
"I acknowledge … The boundary is … The evidence is … I can offer …" — use all four parts in each objection.
